USER EVIDENCE AND SCOPE
Screenshot for DSCF9172.JPG reports GetThumb0x100A returned21314 bytes and
the old completeness check did not find FF D9 at the end of that response.
The screenshot does not contain the response bytes. It establishes the check
that failed, but cannot prove whether EOI is present earlier or truly absent.

CONFIRMED CODE GAP
The old controller and thumbnail cache only accept SOI at the beginning and
EOI in the final two bytes. A complete JPEG followed by auxiliary bytes fails
that test. The new Fuji-only GetThumb normalization locates the main image's
EOI by walking JPEG marker segments and scan data. It returns only the bytes
through an existing EOI, making the result suitable for the unchanged grid,
detail cache and JPEG completeness checks.

APP/EXIF segment lengths skip embedded JPEGs and their EOI. Entropy stuffing,
restart/fill markers and multiple scans are handled. Truncated or unrecognized
payloads are left intact; no EOI is appended and no embedded JPEG is promoted
as a substitute. Only GetThumb is normalized; original transport and saved
original validation remain unchanged. Normalized previews use the existing
bounded in-session cache and independent caller arrays.

TESTS RUN THIS ROUND
tests/run-fuji.ps1: PASS
  Real ImageIO-encoded baseline and progressive JPEGs with zero/nonzero suffix
  data, including a synthetic21314-byte response. Normalized bytes match the
  JPEG exactly; both formats decode to32x24 pixels. Input arrays are unchanged.
  APP1 containing an entire nested JPEG must not terminate the outer image.
  Every truncated prefix of the nested-image fixtures remains unmodified.
  Invalid segment lengths0/1/65535, missing frame/scan, incomplete prefixes,
  entropy byte stuffing, restart markers, marker fill and multiple scans.
  Scripted fragmented PTP transport proves normalization before return/cache,
  one camera read for repeated grid/detail access, independent returned bytes,
  non-caching of a genuinely missing EOI, and exact original-transfer bytes
  even when the original suffix fails later controller validation.
  Existing handshake, scalar, batch/cache, framing and cancellation cases pass.

LIMITS
No raw user-camera payload was captured; synthetic fixture length21314 is not
represented as the user's actual bytes. The suffix compatibility gap is fixed
and tested, while real X-T20 preview success still needs hardware confirmation.
Genuinely truncated previews continue to fail instead of being repaired.
No native Android UI, new real-camera performance measurement, real original
JPEG download, photo-live or RAF capability is claimed this round. Previous
APKs/validation records remain. No unchanged Wi-Fi/preferences suites claimed
rerun; existing unrelated USB fixture limitation remains in the v62 record.

REFERENCES CONSULTED
https://github.com/petabyt/libfuji/blob/master/lib/fuji.c
  fuji_get_thumb returns the GetThumb payload as preview bytes.
https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/blob/main/src/jdmarker.c
  Marker processing treats M_EOI as JPEG_REACHED_EOI and skips APP segments.
  The new marker walker is independently implemented Java, not copied source.

RETRY
Install0.12.4 over the current app, restart the X-T20 wireless session and
confirm the phone on the camera. Browse grid and open the affected photo.
The existing diagnostic dialog remains available if the actual payload
is genuinely incomplete or differs from the handled JPEG structure.
